source.title: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
source.description: If you wish to take on this task, present Lydros with the dull blade.
source.objective: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.
source.completion: If you manage to enter the lair of the dragon, heat the blade under her fiery breath, and ultimately temper it in her blood, I shall bind the blade for your use.
